Same-file serial: open PR #27533 (the fix for #27462, a count roll-up saving without `summaryOperations.field`) edits `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/ObjectFieldInspector.tsx` `SummaryConfigFields` and its test, plus `ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/studio/en.ts` / `zh.ts` and `packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts` — the region this card's picker half changes. State `pm:queue` → `pm:blocked`; the unlock scan puts it back when #27462 closes.

Known traps for the dispatch after the unlock (read-only premise check on `origin/main` `57c51aab4d`):
- Autosave half: `studio-design/metadataError.ts` `objectHeldEdit` (~705–722) holds only what the object write guard refuses (`guardNeedOf` ~688–692 knows `options` and `target`); a `summary` without `summaryOperations` is accepted (200 + `field/summary-without-operations` diagnostic, `packages/spec/src/kernel/functional-completeness.ts` ~110), so it is saved at once. `FIELD_INPUT_KEYS.summaryOperations` (~290) exists for "Show me".
- Picker half: `SummaryConfigFields` `aggregateOptions` is `childFields.filter(f => !f.hidden)` with no type filter; the local `SUMMARY_NUMERIC_TYPES` (~2296) is used only for filter-value coercion. No spec-exported rule names which field types sum/avg accept; read what #27533 lands before choosing the source (triage: one rule, no second list).
